typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		SourceSystem as string,
		ItemDefinition as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		SchemaNAme as string,
		DatabaseId as integer,
		Origin as string,
		DBName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select distinct   		SchemaNAme=cast(\'dbo\' as nvarchar(50)) 		,TableName =cast( rtrim(ltrim(isnull( case when  SRC_Column like \'%.%\' then substring(SRC_Column,1,	 CHARINDEX(\'.\', SRC_Column, 1) -1) else \'DuckCreek\'  end ,\'Not Available\'))) as nvarchar(75)) 		,ColumnName=cast(rtrim(ltrim(isnull( case when    SRC_Column like \'%.%\' then substring( SRC_Column,	 CHARINDEX(\'.\', SRC_Column, 1) +1 ,len(SRC_Column))  					else SRC_Column 						end ,\'Not Available\') 					)) 					as nvarchar(75))    							 		,[SourceSystem] = cast(\'DuckCreek\' as nvarchar(50))			  		,ItemDefinition=cast(SRC_Column as nvarchar(300)) 		,DatabaseId=0		 		,Cast(\'C\' as nchar(1)) [TableColumnValueFlag] 		,Origin=Cast(          \'DuckCreek\'  as nvarchar(25)) 		,DBName 		 FROM (   		 SELECT 			  DatabaseType =cast(\'Staging\' as nvarchar(25)) 			  , SourceFrom= cast(A.SourceFrom as nvarchar(max)) 			 ,Split.a.value(\'.\', \'nVARCHAR(max)\') AS SRC_Column   			, [TargetMapping],DBName 		 FROM  (SELECT [TargetMapping],DBName, 		 SourceFrom				 ,CAST (\'<M>\' + REPLACE(SourceFrom, \',\', \'</M><M>\') + \'</M>\' AS XML) AS String   				  FROM (select [TargetMapping],DBName, 				  SourceFrom =Replace(SourceFrom,\'\'\'\',\'\')              					  from  (SELECT  [TargetMapping],DBName 									,cast(replace(p.SourceFrom,\'+\',\',\') as nvarchar(1000)) as \'SourceFrom\'							FROM    [Temp].[ExtendedProperties] p 					   									) s                                 ) m                 where SourceFrom <> \'Unknown\'                                   ) AS A CROSS APPLY String.nodes (\'/M\') AS Split(a)  				 )x',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC	source(output(
		PhysicalItemId as integer,
		SchemaName as string,
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		ValueName as string,
		LinkLevel as string,
		Type as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		DomainId as string,
		Id as string,
		Deleted as integer,
		InScopeFlag as boolean,
		Origin as string,
		SourceSystem as string,
		ItemDefinition as string,
		StewardGroupId as integer,
		Databaseid as integer,
		IsNullable as boolean,
		InScopeFlagDate as timestamp,
		AnalysisStatusDate as timestamp,
		AnalysisStatusId as integer,
		PhysicalItemIdSource as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Tracker.PhysicalItem',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@Origin == LookupLKPTABLE@Origin && SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@TableName == LookupLKPTABLE@TableName && SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@ColumnName == LookupLKPTABLE@ColumnName && SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@DatabaseId == LookupLKPTABLE@Databaseid && SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@SchemaNAme == LookupLKPTABLE@SchemaName,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		TableName = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@TableName,
		ColumnName = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@ColumnName,
		SourceSystem = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@SourceSystem,
		ItemDefinition = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@ItemDefinition,
		TableColumnValueFlag = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@TableColumnValueFlag,
		SchemaNAme = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@SchemaNAme,
		DatabaseId = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@DatabaseId,
		Origin = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@Origin,
		DBName = DBName,
		PhysicalItemId = PhysicalItemId,
		SchemaName = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@SchemaNAme,
		ValueName = ValueName,
		LinkLevel = LinkLevel,
		Type = Type,
		DomainId = DomainId,
		Id = Id,
		Deleted = Deleted,
		InScopeFlag = InScopeFlag,
		StewardGroupId = StewardGroupId,
		Databaseid = SRCextpropertiesfromstagingDC@DatabaseId,
		IsNullable = IsNullable,
		InScopeFlagDate = InScopeFlagDate,
		AnalysisStatusDate = AnalysisStatusDate,
		AnalysisStatusId = AnalysisStatusId,
		PhysicalItemIdSource = PhysicalItemIdSource
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		Origin as string,
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		ItemDefinition as string,
		Databaseid as integer,
		SourceSystem as string,
		SchemaName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Origin,
		TableName,
		ColumnName,
		TableColumnValueFlag,
		ItemDefinition,
		Databaseid = DatabaseId,
		SourceSystem,
		SchemaName = SchemaNAme)) ~> DSTTrackerphysicalITem
